purpose: Record an external hourly-reversal finding without opening a project trial or inspecting project candidate returns.

sources_reviewed.title: Diagnostic expectations and cryptocurrency returns
sources_reviewed.journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
sources_reviewed.finding_used: The accessible publisher record reports broad negative predictability from a prior one-hour return to subsequent one-to-four-hour returns across Binance USDT pairs, including BTC and ETH.

candidates.name: HOURLY_CROSS_SECTIONAL_RETURN_REVERSAL
candidates.reason: The accessible publication record establishes a research finding but does not disclose a complete executable strategy contract: point-in-time tradable membership, fixed signal threshold or ranking rule, number and weighting of positions, exact hold and overlap treatment, funding treatment, and executable fee/spread/slippage assumptions. Filling those choices from project returns would create a post-hoc parameter search and would overlap the sealed Alpha 002 mean-reversion family.
required_before_any_preregistration: a primary-source supplement or author-provided protocol that fixes the selection and portfolio construction rule before project returns are read
a point-in-time historical or forward contract-status and liquidity universe matching the rule
a preregistered funding-aware execution and turnover budget
an independence review against Alpha 002 that identifies a materially different information set and horizon

rationale: Do not substitute an under-specified literature result with tuned project parameters. Continue sealed forward collection and the existing point-in-time universe protocol.
